name: Mercure Khiva
desc: Mercure Hotel Khiva is a sophisticated 4-star hotel in Khiva inspired by the history of the Uzbekistan Silk Road. By the ancient walled city of Ichan Kala, the hotel offers an indoor pool, a hammam and a spa preserving local wellness customs. Our soulful restaurants celebrate regional culinary heritage, and at sunset, the citadel and desert views from The Terrace at Ark are captivating. Three modern meeting spaces…

name: Mövenpick Samarkand
desc: Movenpick Samarkand Hotel locates in the heart of Samarkand, close to sights, mosques, mausoleums and the city business center. This Silk Road oasis is ideal for business trips and leisure. Registan Square, Gur-Emir Mausoleum, Bibi Khanum Mosque and El Merosi Theatre are all on the hotel doorstep. With a garden view and an outdoor veranda, our restaurant Atrium serves European and Uzbek dishes.

name: Swissôtel Tashkent
desc: Swissotel Tashkent is a haven of wellness and harmony along the ancient Silk Road. Stay at our luxury hotel in Tashkent city centre and indulge in our Swiss spa with private hammams before taking a dip in the pool. At Safran Restaurant, savour the aromas of local spices and sample Swiss fondue paired with beloved Uzbek plov. name: Mercure Tashkent South
desc: Mercure Hotel Tashkent South is designed for business trips and leisure. There are many reasons to book accommodation here: it is located near the airport, business centers, historical attractions. There are conference halls with modern equipment that are suitable for meetings and events. Choose a spacious room or suite and enjoy the beautiful view, plenty of storage space and space where you can feel at home.

name: Ibis Tashkent Index
desc: Ibis Tashkent Index hotel located in the in the industrial business park, Tashkent Index. Comfortable rooms with innovate Sweet Bed by Ibis, Conference room for up to 65 guests, two boardrooms provide everything needed for relaxation or effective business performance.
